title: napRider-napoli97
name: naprider-napoli97
summary: Naples, 1997: drive a white Fiat 500 L through six districts, dodge the scooter gangs and find the Egg of Virgil.
description: An unofficial horizontal-parallax arcade adventure set in Naples in 1997. Drive a white 1971 Fiat 500 L through Centro Storico, Posillipo, the Quartieri Spagnoli, Vomero by night and Parco Virgiliano, collect five Virgilian mosaic fragments while scooter gangs block and chase you, refuel at the pumps, light the tunnels, then descend into Napoli Sotterranea and choose whether to take or leave the legendary Egg of Virgil. Palette-indexed pixel art with exact colours on the ESP32-C6, palette effects, and an original eight-track SID-like soundtrack with stereo-panned effects.
controls: UP/DOWN lanes, RIGHT accelerate, LEFT brake, A turbo or gadget, B self-drive, SELECT handbrake, SELECT+B headlights
fiction_notice: An unofficial tribute. The story mixes real places and the legend of Virgil's Egg with invented events. Fiat and Vespa are named descriptively as period vehicles; no logos, trademarks, television characters or soundtrack are reproduced and no affiliation is implied.

colophon.title: napRider-napoli97
colophon.subtitle: Tra mito, storia e asfalto
technology: PRG32 portable ABI-table cartridge; runs in every cartridge-RAM profile from 32 KiB
4-bpp palette-indexed tiles and sprites, one colour per system-cube cell for exact colours on the ESP32-C6
palette effects: district fades, unlit tunnels, fragment flash, shimmering sea, torch and Egg glow
three-layer horizontal parallax with sky gradients on reserved palette entries
ten SID-like procedural instruments, eight tracker tracks, stereo-panned effects on four voices
acknowledgements: Naples in 1997 and the legend of Virgil's Egg inspire a fictional story
Original soundtrack; no television theme or traditional melody is quoted
colophon.content_notice: Unofficial tribute game. napRider is a playful name; the project is not affiliated with Knight Rider, Fiat/Stellantis, Piaggio, municipal institutions, or custodians of Naples cultural sites.

controls.action: Accelerate / brake; in self-drive, choose the gadget
Turbo; in self-drive, use the gadget; take the Egg
